about.title: About Opulanz
about.subtitle: The All-in-One Platform for Businesses
about.storyIntro: Opulanz is a brand of Groupe Advensys Luxembourg S.A., a holding company with over 19 years of experience in comprehensive business solutions across Europe. We built Opulanz with a clear vision: to simplify and bring together, in one place, the financial and operational services that businesses need.
about.missionText: To improve the ecosystem of business financial services, payments, and operational processes through modern technologies, including AI.
about.visionText: To become a European reference for online business services, leveraging our intermediary and advisory statuses to offer flexibility and quality of service.
about.storyClosing: Today, we support commercial companies, financial institutions, investment funds, and freelancers across Europe, with the highest standards of security, compliance, and service.
about.impactSubtitle: Our growth reflects the trust our clients place in us
about.strengthsDescription: The pillars of our commitment to our clients
about.strength1Description: Over 19 years serving commercial companies, financial institutions, and investment funds across Europe.
about.strength2Description: From company formation assistance to financial services: accounting, tax advisory, investment advisory, and insurance.
about.strength3Description: AI for simpler and more efficient services.
about.licensesDescription: Our regulated activities are carried out by licensed entities within the group:
about.cert1Description: Advensys Insurance-Finance, ORIAS n° 21003660: broker (banking operations, payment services, insurance) under ACPR supervision, and Investment Adviser (CIF) under AMF supervision.
about.cert2Description: Carried out under authorisation of the Ministry of Economy of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.
about.cert3Description: Provided through our licensed partner, an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) authorised within the European Union.

We are not liable for any losses resulting from service interruptions or delays in processing transactions.

s5.content: Our platform may contain links to or integrate with third-party websites, services, or products. Your interactions with third-party services are governed by their respective terms and conditions. We are not liable for any damages or losses resulting from your use of third-party services.

s6.content: Opulanz operates under licenses and regulations in specific jurisdictions. Our services may not be available in all countries or regions. It is your responsibility to ensure that your use of our services complies with local laws and regulations in your jurisdiction. We make no representation that materials on our platform are appropriate or available for use in all locations.

s7.title: 7. Exchange Rate and Currency Disclaimer
s7.content: Exchange rates displayed on our platform are indicative and may not reflect real-time market rates. Actual rates applied to transactions may differ based on market conditions, transaction size, and timing. Currency exchange involves risk, and rates can fluctuate significantly. We are not responsible for losses resulting from exchange rate movements.

s8.content: Information provided regarding tax matters is general in nature and should not be considered as tax advice. Tax laws vary by jurisdiction and individual circumstances. You are responsible for understanding and complying with your tax obligations. We recommend consulting with qualified tax professionals for advice specific to your situation. Opulanz is not responsible for any tax liabilities you may incur.

s9.title: 9. Insurance Coverage Disclaimer
s9.content: Insurance products offered through our platform are provided by licensed insurance companies. We act as an intermediary and are not the insurance provider. We do not provide legal advice regarding corporate structure, governance, or compliance. The suitability of a particular corporate structure depends on your specific circumstances and objectives. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions.

openAccount.question: How long does it take to open an account?
openAccount.answer: Individual accounts are typically approved within 24–48 hours. Business accounts take 3–5 business days depending on the complexity of the application.

documents.question: What documents do I need?
documents.answer: For individuals: a valid government-issued ID, proof of address, and a selfie. For businesses: company registration documents, UBO declaration, and director IDs.

fees.question: What are the monthly fees?
fees.answer: Individual accounts start at €10/month. Business accounts start at €25/month. Full fee schedules are available in your account settings.

currencies.question: Which currencies are supported?
currencies.answer: We support EUR, USD, GBP, and CHF. Each account comes with a dedicated multi-currency IBAN for seamless international payments.

contact.question: How do I contact my account manager?
contact.answer: Once your account is approved, you will be assigned a dedicated account manager reachable by email or phone during business hours.

hero.title: Regulatory Information
hero.subtitle: Our commitment to compliance and regulatory oversight

regulatory.intro: Opulanz operates under strict regulatory oversight to ensure the highest standards of financial integrity, client protection, and operational transparency.

framework.title: Regulatory Framework
framework.description: Opulanz is regulated by leading European financial authorities. Our operations comply with:
framework.mifid2: Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II)
framework.french: Banking and financial services regulations in France

acpr.name: ACPR
acpr.fullNameFr: Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution
acpr.description: The French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority supervises banks, insurance companies, and financial institutions operating in France.

amf.name: AMF
amf.description: The French Financial Markets Authority regulates financial markets, investment services, and protects investors.

compliance.title: Compliance Standards
compliance.description: We maintain the highest compliance standards across all aspects of our operations:

aml.title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
aml.description: We implement comprehensive AML policies and procedures to detect and prevent money laundering activities. This includes ongoing transaction monitoring, suspicious activity reporting, and staff training programs.

kyc.title: Know Your Customer (KYC)
kyc.description: All clients undergo thorough identity verification and due diligence procedures. We collect and verify personal information, beneficial ownership details, and source of funds to ensure regulatory compliance.

ctf.title: Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF)
ctf.description: We screen all clients and transactions against international sanctions lists and watchlists to prevent terrorist financing and comply with international security regulations.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.description: We comply with GDPR and implement robust data protection measures to safeguard your personal information. Your data is processed lawfully, transparently, and securely.

clientFunds.title: Client Fund Protection
clientFunds.description: Client funds are held in segregated accounts with licensed banking partners and are protected according to applicable deposit guarantee schemes. Your funds are kept separate from company operational funds.

licenses.title: Licenses and Authorizations
licenses.description: Opulanz holds the necessary licenses and authorizations to provide financial services:

banking.title: Banking Services - France
banking.authority: Licensed and supervised by ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution)
banking.note: Our French banking operations are fully compliant with French banking law and European banking directives.

investment.title: Investment Services - France
investment.authority: Regulated by AMF (Autorité des Marchés Financiers)
investment.note: Our investment advisory services comply with MiFID II regulations and AMF requirements.

payment.title: Payment Services
payment.note: We provide secure payment services across the European Economic Area in compliance with PSD2 requirements.

contact.title: Questions About Our Regulatory Status?
contact.description: For inquiries about our licenses, compliance procedures, or regulatory matters, please contact our compliance team.

overview.benefit1: 19+ years of European financial services expertise
overview.benefit2: Access to multiple partner banks simultaneously

howItWorks.title: Four steps to your mortgage offer

step1.title: Pre-Qualification
step1.description: Tell us about your project — property type, price, contribution, income, and employment. We review your eligibility before any bank is contacted.

step2.title: Document Collection
step2.description: Upload your supporting documents securely. Your file is automatically checked against our bank-ready checklist.

step3.title: Bank Submission
step3.description: With your consent, your complete file is transmitted to partner banks — encrypted, compliant, and fully confidential.

step4.title: Offer & Signature
step4.description: Receive bank offers in your Opulanz dashboard. Compare, choose the best option, and proceed to signature.

features.title: Professional mortgage brokerage expertise
features.description: As a regulated credit intermediary, we provide expert guidance and multi-bank access for your property financing in France and Luxembourg.

expertise.title: Local Expertise
expertise.description: Deep knowledge of lending requirements in France and Luxembourg, including cross-border and non-resident profiles.

secure.title: Secure & GDPR
secure.description: Documents encrypted on Azure infrastructure, processed in full GDPR compliance, and purged after completion.

multibank.title: Multi-Bank Access
multibank.description: Simultaneous submission to multiple partner banks to maximise your chances and find the most competitive rate.

tracking.title: Real-Time Tracking
tracking.description: Follow every step of your application — from document upload to signed offer — directly in your Opulanz account.
